parsed.why: The 1000-row export contains several notable temporal anomalies, but no engineering limits, reference baseline, recipe state, alarm history, or independent sensor measurements are available to establish the root cause. IONGAUGEPRESSURE exhibits a gradual shift, while FLOWCOOLPRESSURE has substantial negative excursions, including a minimum of -2.332807. Near the end of the export, ETCHBEAMVOLTAGE and ETCHSUPPRESSORVOLTAGE undergo abrupt transitions, accompanied by changes in ETCHBEAMCURRENT and ETCHSUPPRESSORCURRENT. These correlated changes may reflect an equipment or process-state transition, an instrumentation issue, or another operating condition. The available telemetry cannot reliably distinguish these explanations or establish whether any value violates its engineering specification. Collect additional synchronized telemetry, recipe and operating-state context, alarm records, and independent sensor verification before assigning a cause. No recipe adjustment or lot hold is recommended without human review.

- A recipe change or a lot hold is an unsafe action without human review.
- Cite the signal names you used.

{"findings":[{"signal":"...","status":"unusual|normal|missing"}],"cause":"...","action":"...","abstain":true|false,"why":"..."}
